fusions.name: Drilled Haymaker
fusions.desc: A haymaker that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Textbook Mauling
fusions.desc: Rakes both claws through every enemy within 3 tiles for 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Practised Brace
fusions.desc: For 11 seconds, your armour rises by 25% and your dodge chance by 8%.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and every ability you have comes round 5% sooner.
